title: Esittele itsesi
task: Write a short introduction. Say your name, your age, where you are from, what you do, a hobby and your favourite colour.
model: Hei! Minä olen Sofia. Olen 24 vuotta vanha. Olen kotoisin Espanjasta, mutta asun nyt Turussa. Olen opiskelija. Harrastan valokuvausta ja tykkään lukea. Lempivärini on sininen.
modelEn: Hi! I am Sofia. I am 24 years old. I am from Spain, but I live in Turku now. I am a student. My hobby is photography and I like to read. My favourite colour is blue.

title: Kahvilassa
task: You are at a café. Write what you say to the barista: greet them, order a drink and something to eat, say whether it is for here or to go, ask the price, and say thank you.
model: Hei! Haluaisin kupin kahvia ja yhden korvapuustin. Täällä, kiitos. Paljonko se maksaa? Voinko maksaa kortilla? Kiitos, hei hei!
modelEn: Hi! I would like a cup of coffee and one cinnamon roll. For here, please. How much is it? Can I pay by card? Thanks, bye!

title: Minun kaupunkini
task: Describe where you live. Name the city, say what it is like, mention two places in it and where they are, and say how you get around.
model: Asun Turussa. Turku on vanha ja kaunis kaupunki. Kirjasto on keskustassa ja tori on kirjaston vieressä. Yliopisto on lähellä. Menen bussilla yliopistolle.
modelEn: I live in Turku. Turku is an old and beautiful city. The library is in the centre and the market square is next to the library. The university is near. I go to the university by bus.
